Amigo's in Waterloo. Honest review, because I would want one before I drove out there.

The atmosphere is charming and I genuinely loved the vibe. Painted cactus, the whole room, it is a nice place to sit.

The Paloma was an 8 out of 10. It was tasty. I did not want a second one though, and for me that is the line between tasty and delicious.

The tamale was good but not outstanding, and I would rather tell you that than pretend it changed my life.

Overall 7.5 out of 10, and I would eat there again, which is the part that actually matters.

One thing I did not expect to enjoy as much as I did: the menu tells you how to pronounce every dish. Tah-mah-leh. Chee-lay-ray-yeh-noh. Somebody made a decision there and I respect it.

Nobody asked me to post this and nobody is paying me. I ate there, I liked it, that is the whole story.

She checks the whole yard, patch by patch.

Pink harness, leash trailing out behind her, nose down in the grass. The dandelions are open. Half the yard is in sun and half is in shade and she walks through both.

Nothing really happens here. She goes slow, covers the ground she wants to cover, and at the end she stops where the grass runs out and looks straight up at me.
